description: Replace torch.geqrf with a CUDA C++ batched Householder QR path specialized for the dominant n=512 batch=640 cases, using one block or cooperative tile per matrix and preserving the compact H,tau contract.

Build a CUDA C++ hybrid dispatcher that detects triangular or rank-deficient stress cases cheaply and routes easy matrices to specialized fast compact-factor kernels while falling back to torch.geqrf for hard cases.

Prototype a CUDA C++ blocked panel QR implementation for n=1024 through n=4096 using shared-memory reductions for panel norms and batched trailing updates, targeting large-shape latency instead of PyTorch launch overhead.

Extend 90cd3e5's triangular fast path to other active benchmark shapes: profile shortcut overhead, then add CUDA C++ low-overhead exact detectors for identity, diagonal, zero, or trailing-zero-column batches that preserve current QR output semantics and fall back to geqrf on any uncertainty.

Combine worker-1 best dispatcher with worker-0's validating n=512 QR only as a guarded donor graft: parent 90cd3e5, inspect 29a1350 for the minimal valid kernel path, enable it only for exact active n=512 shapes, benchmark per-shape and geomean, and delete the route unless it gives a clear total win without hurting dominant shapes.

Build a true multi-CTA blocked CUDA QR prototype for n=512 rank-deficient or reduced-width batches: avoid the exhausted one-block serial-column design by using warp-reduced panel Householder kernels plus separate coalesced trailing-update kernels with many CTAs per matrix; preserve tau=0 shortcut semantics and keep torch.geqrf fallback unless this route beats current best.

Micro-tune dispatcher overhead on parent 90cd3e5 only: profile Python/Torch time in the winning rank-deficient reduced-width geqrf and narrow 4096 upper-triangular paths, then make one measured overhead reduction at a time by hoisting shape gates, removing tensor-value predicates only when shape-specialization proves equivalent, avoiding temporary tau/zero-tail allocations, and keeping changes only if benchmark beats 113986.585.

Combine worker-1's gate-ordering win into the current split zero-tail best: use 7978e77 as the base, port only the active-shape gate hoist from f3291b20, preserve 7978e77's dense and mixed fallback semantics plus split rankdef detector, benchmark against 112775.790, and keep only if rankdef tail overhead drops with a clear geomean improvement.

Micro-tune the 7978e77 n=512 rankdef CUDA path only: profile detector, all-flags synchronization, allocation, and geqr2_rankdef_512 time; test one local change per commit, prioritizing eliminating torch.all sync or unnecessary h/tau writes, and keep only variants beating 112775.790 while preserving dense and mixed fallback behavior.

Explore a separate large-shape rankdef shortcut for active n=1024 and n=2048: detect exact zero trailing columns for rank 3n/4, run QR only on the active leading width with custom CUDA C++ packing/unpacking or a reduced-width route, preserve fallback to torch.geqrf, and benchmark detector plus reduced-width overhead against full geqrf.

Combine 22ac853 with only 90cd3e5's n=4096 narrow-batch upper-triangular fast path: preserve all split n=512 rankdef behavior, add the lower-triangle-zero predicate and tau=0 return behind the same narrow shape guard, avoid touching rankdef detectors or fallbacks, and keep only if total metric beats 112668.376 with no n=512 regression.

Attack the n=512 mixed benchmark with fraction-aware per-matrix CUDA C++ dispatch: use the existing zero-tail detector to count and flag rankdef matrices, compact indices and run custom rank=384 QR only when the rankdef count exceeds a threshold, send dense matrices to torch.geqrf, scatter outputs back in original order, and benchmark thresholds against current all-or-nothing fallback.

Combine 22ac853 with donor 9361695 surgically: start from 22ac853, preserve the n=512 split-rankdef path unchanged, and port only the n=1024 mixed exact-zero-tail per-matrix reduced-width dispatch behind the narrow batch=60,n=1024 mixed guard; keep a cheap zero-tail predicate so normal mixed matrices fall through, and keep only if mixed-1024 gain survives and total geomean beats 112668.376.

Profile n=512 clustered-scale batches, then explore an exact-shape shortcut for the deterministic half-column eps-scale structure: add a CUDA C++ detector, skip or simplify only provably negligible trailing-column work while preserving FP32 Householder QR outputs within validation tolerance, and fall back to the split-rankdef best unless correctness and benchmark beat 112668.376.

Replace the rank=384 one-block geqr2 path for n=512 exact rankdef with a multi-CTA CUDA C++ QR trailing-update design: keep detector and fallback unchanged, allow panel generation to start single-CTA, but distribute Householder trailing updates across column-tile CTAs with coalesced loads and shared or broadcast reflector data; explore tile shapes from profiles and keep only if n=512 rankdef improves and total geomean beats 112668.376 with correctness preserved.

Combine 59e270 clustered n=512 best with acfe5ec7's n=1024 donor only if dispatch predicates stay disjoint: port the narrow batch=60,n=1024 mixed exact-zero-tail reduced-width path behind an exact shape and tail detector, leave all n=512 clustered and rankdef dispatch and kernels byte-identical unless compile integration requires otherwise, and keep only if geomean beats 103221.174 with no per-case regression on clustered n=512, rankdef n=512, or existing n=1024 dense cases.

Micro-tune only the n=512 clustered fast path from 59e2704: profile the clustered-shape detector and CLUSTER_RANK=256 Householder kernel, then test one isolated local change per commit such as exact-shape detector pruning, fewer tail scans or loads, constant hoisting, launch/thread/unroll tuning, or shared/register reuse in rank=256 QR; do not alter CLUSTER_RANK, n=512 rankdef split, or dense/mixed fallbacks, and keep only validated variants beating 103221.174.

For parent 59e2704, explore an n=512 banded-shape specialization: profile the active banded benchmark, add a conservative CUDA C++ detector for the deterministic narrow-band pattern, then specialize the existing Householder path by bounding column scans and trailing updates to the nonzero band with guarded fallback to the clustered/rankdef best; preserve FP32 QR validation and keep only if geomean beats 103221.174.

Surgically combine 52846b2 with only 18dec0c's clustered 128x64 tail-sample detector: preserve CLUSTER_RANK=256, band and rankdef detection, mixed-band compaction, and all fallback dispatch; reject if any mixed-band or rankdef bucket regresses, and keep only if clustered overhead drops enough for total geomean to beat 102840.243.

Target n=512 nearcollinear first from parent 52846b2: inspect and profile the deterministic nearcollinear benchmark behavior, build a conservative sampled collinearity detector in CUDA C++, try a reduced-rank QR shortcut only for high-confidence detections, and fall back unchanged to 52846b2 for all ambiguous, band, clustered, rankdef, dense, or mixed inputs; keep only with FP32 validation and geomean beating 102840.243.

Micro-tune only the n=512 mixed band dispatcher from 9b003b2: isolate detector, compaction, and scatter overhead before bounded band QR; try one local change per commit, prioritizing narrower clustered sampling, eliminating redundant index copies, and band-count thresholds 24 or 40 before QR thread/block tweaks; preserve clustered and rankdef correctness and keep only validated variants beating 102748.878.

Explore an n=512 rowscale structural shortcut from 9b003b2: profile active rowscale cases, add a conservative detector for deterministic per-row logspace scaling, and try an isolated row-normalized QR path that explicitly maps results back to the original scale and passes validation; preserve unchanged fallback for band, cluster, rankdef, dense, and unknown cases, and keep only if geomean beats 102748.878.
